_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: kind: feature. Appointment confirmation flow. Adds the ConfirmationToken schema with token lifecycle (active → redeemed | revoked | expired) and extends the Appointment schema with confirmation fields (confirmationDeadline, confirmedAt, confirmationTokenId) and the matching pending_confirmation → confirmed lifecycle transitions. Both schemas are additive over bookings-create-appointment (which already owns the Appointment monolith), merged via SettingsService:deepMergeConfig (ADR-037). No PHP model classes. Tokens are managed as OR objects through ConfirmationApiController + ConfirmationTokenService.

confirmationDeadline.description: Latest time the customer can confirm before the appointment is auto-cancelled by the CancelUnconfirmedAppointments background job. ISO 8601 UTC. Typically appointment.createdAt + 48h.
confirmationDeadline.title: Confirmation Deadline

confirmedAt.description: Timestamp when the appointment transitioned from pending_confirmation to confirmed. Set by ConfirmationApiController:confirm on successful token redemption.
confirmedAt.title: Confirmed At

confirmationTokenId.description: FK to the currently-active ConfirmationToken.tokenId. Updated on token resend. Null for admin-created appointments that start as confirmed.
confirmationTokenId.title: Confirmation Token ID

confirmViaToken.label: Confirm via token
confirmViaToken.description: Customer redeemed a valid ConfirmationToken; status moves to confirmed and confirmedAt is set.

autoCancelExpired.label: Auto-cancel after deadline
autoCancelExpired.description: Confirmation deadline passed and the appointment is still pending; the CancelUnconfirmedAppointments background job moves it to cancelled with reason 'Confirmation deadline passed'.

ConfirmationToken.title: Confirmation Token
ConfirmationToken.description: A short-lived secret used by a customer to confirm a pending appointment via email link or web portal. Tokens are stored as salted bcrypt hashes (never plaintext) by TokenValidator. Lifecycle: active → redeemed (on confirmation) or revoked (on resend) or expired (when expiresAt passes). One Appointment may have multiple ConfirmationToken rows over time (e.g. after resend); the appointment's confirmationTokenId points at the current active token.

tokenId.description: Unique token identifier (UUID) within the tenant.
tokenId.title: Token ID

appointmentId.description: FK to Appointment.appointmentId: the appointment this token confirms.
appointmentId.title: Appointment ID

tokenString.description: Salted bcrypt hash of the 32-character URL-safe random token. Never stored in plaintext. Validated in constant time by TokenValidator:validate.
tokenString.title: Token String

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at which the token becomes invalid. Defaults to creation + 7 days per design D5.
expiresAt.title: Expires At

status.description: Token lifecycle state. active = usable; redeemed = consumed by a successful confirmation; revoked = invalidated by a resend; expired = expiresAt has passed.
status.title: Status

redeemedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the token was successfully redeemed to confirm the appointment.
redeemedAt.title: Redeemed At

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC token-creation timestamp (auto-set on save).
createdAt.title: Created At

createdBy.description: User ID that triggered token creation. 'system' for auto-generated on appointment creation; admin/customer ID for manual resend.
createdBy.title: Created By

active.label: Active
active.description: Token is valid and may be redeemed.

redeemed.label: Redeemed
redeemed.description: Token has been used to confirm the appointment; cannot be reused.

revoked.label: Revoked
revoked.description: Token has been invalidated by a resend request; a fresh active token replaces it.

expired.label: Expired
expired.description: Token's expiresAt has passed; the CancelUnconfirmedAppointments background job marks the row expired.

redeem.label: Redeem token
redeem.description: Customer presented the matching token to confirm the appointment.

revoke.label: Revoke token
revoke.description: Customer requested a fresh confirmation email; old token invalidated.

expire.label: Expire token
expire.description: expiresAt passed without redemption; deadline job marks the token expired.

x-openregister-rbac.description: Tokens are server-issued (system actor or scheduler resend). Customers can read but not create/update. Auditors are read-only for audit trail traceability.
